I added a looping synthwave track to Neon Snake. It runs at 128 bpm with a four-on-the-floor kick, hi-hats, a driving bass and a bright arpeggio. A lead melody comes in on the second half of the loop. The loop is about 56 seconds, which is longer than the 20–40 s you asked for. The playtest passed with no errors, but I can't hear audio here, so I haven't heard how it sounds. The music starts on the first tap.

I didn't change anything else in the game.
